typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FailureMail as string (),
	FileExists as boolean (),
	FileMemberCnt_Invalid as integer (),
	FileMemberCnt_Total as integer (),
	FileMemberCnt_Valid as integer (),
	GRGR_CK as integer (),
	InboundArchiveFilePath as string (),
	InboundFileFullName as string (),
	InboundFileName as string (),
	InboundFileName_Invalid as string (),
	InboundFilePath as string (),
	InboundFilePrefix as string (),
	InvalidMemberTbl as string (),
	MarketCode as string (),
	SuccessEmailMessage as string (),
	SuccessEmailSubject as string (),
	SuccessMail_CC as string (),
	SuccessMail_To as string ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFMINDOULAEXCLUDE
FFMINDOULAEXCLUDE derive(MarketName = 'LA',
		GRGR_CK = 28,
		SBSB_ID = rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString(SBSB_ID),' ')),' ')) ~> DerivedColumn
FFMINDOULAEXCLUDE aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> CNTTotalAGGREGATE
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MarketName as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MarketName,
		GRGR_CK,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> OLEDBMindoulaSMIMembersLKP
CNTTotalAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> CNTTotalCACHESINK
